mapper.select: SELECT S.STORE_NO, SU.S_USER_ID, SU.U_STATUS, S.STORE_NAME, S.S_CATEGORY, S.S_ADDR, S.S_FULL_ADDR, S.S_STATUS, SF.FILE_PATH, SF.FILE_NAME, SF.ORIGIN_NAME FROM STORE S LEFT JOIN STORE_USER SU ON S.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID LEFT JOIN STORE_FILE SF ON S.STORE_NO = SF.STORE_NO AND SF.IS_PROOF = 'Y' WHERE S.S_STATUS = 'PND' AND SU.U_STATUS = 'PND';
mapper.update: UPDATE STORE S JOIN STORE_USER SU ON S.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID SET S.S_STATUS = 'GEN', SU.U_STATUS = 'APR' WHERE S.STORE_NO = #{storeNo} AND SU.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId};
